scope: Precomputed award light including original coin scale curve for the 600-tick level-end sequence, and seeded starburst through 100 ticks. Centers translate at LCD pixel resolution. Normal alpha and /256 rounding retained; summed additive colors quantized with a maximum RGB8 error of 8 per channel.
compression: Outer zlib expanded once before play. Prebaked LZ4-HC row streams with local byte palettes expand into two preallocated reusable frame buffers; no playback IO, allocation, particle simulation or texture sampling.
cropping: Only texels outside every reachable viewport of the original 350-tick collection curve are removed; actual LCD center is checked against the stored bounds.
